_notes: Crops are [x, y, w, h] in the camera's own pixels (usually 3840x2160). Get them from: python -I tools/framing.py suggest ...
inset -> 1460x946 (shown 972x630), cell -> 1080x960, full -> 1080x1920. Aspect is enforced by framing.py.
align_with: the camera whose recorded audio matches the final audio best (usually the one with the clean mix).
screen.file: the guest's screen recording, if any; screen.crop optional [x,y,w,h], output 1080 wide.
